opportunities.title: Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million each, plus ring-fenced funding for postdoctoral opportunities (£400,000), administrative support (£225,000) and cohort-building activities (£75,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any UK university holding research degree awarding powers in its own right; applications also accepted from a consortium of a maximum of two universities with one lead. A university may submit only one application as lead but may partner in multiple applications in different disciplinary areas. Applications are not accepted from other UK institutions or organisations.
opportunities.summary: Funds up to 30 Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships in an interdisciplinary priority research area at a UK university (or consortium of two), including 18 four-year UK/home scholarships and 6 international scholarships, plus a master's-plus-PhD route for students from underrepresented groups, postdoctoral opportunities, cohort-building and administrative support. Each award is up to £5 million and runs over 9 years; 10 awards will be made in this round. The scheme is currently open for submission.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligible to UK universities, other institutions of higher education in the UK, and (on a trial basis) UK-based independent research institutes/organisations defined as eligible by UKRI. The Principal Investigator must be employed by the eligible institution, and the institution must agree to administer the grant. Up to three co-applicants (including overseas) may be included.
opportunities.summary: Funds innovative and original research projects at UK universities and HE institutions, held for up to five years with a maximum grant value of £500,000. Assessed via a two-stage process: Outline Applications (currently paused, to be accepted in the new grants management system in autumn 2026) and Detailed Applications (deadline 1 September 2026). At least 75% of resources must fund research staff.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligible institutions are UK universities registered by the Office for Students and holding their own research degree awarding powers. A centre may be based at a single university or be a collaboration between multiple institutions. Each UK university may submit one application as principal applicant but may partner in multiple proposals led by other universities.
opportunities.summary: Funds the establishment of a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship, up to £10 million for up to 10 years. The Centenary Research Centre round is expected to open in February 2027 for submission of outline applications in June 2027. Previously excluded institutions (Universities of Oxford and Cambridge and Imperial College London) will be eligible in this round.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to early career academics who have had at least two years' full-time or equivalent research/teaching experience after PhD award, hold a permanent academic appointment at a UK university at lecturer level or equivalent (or are nominated by a UK university that undertakes to offer a contract for the duration of the award), and have the right to work in the UK. Applicants at Senior Lecturer, Reader/Associate Professor or Professor level are not eligible. Each institution is limited to one bid.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early career scholars embarking on a university career to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem, developing research leadership. Awards up to £1 million over 4-5 years. The Centenary Research Leadership Awards will open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to experienced researchers who hold a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the duration of the Fellowship, are resident in the UK, and are permanent members of the UK scholarly community with an established track record. Priority given to applicants whose teaching and administrative duties have significantly impacted their ability to undertake research.
opportunities.summary: Funds experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research, providing replacement costs and research expenses up to £70,000, tenable for 3-24 months. Approximately 100 Fellowships are offered each year. Application materials will be available on this page in September 2026.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post, live in the UK for a minimum of 26 weeks of the year, hold or have held a teaching and/or research post at a UK university with research degree or taught degree awarding powers or an eligible Independent Research Organisation/Institute, and have an established record of research. All Emeritus Fellowship applications require institutional approval from the 2026 round onwards.
opportunities.summary: Funds senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post to complete a research project and prepare the results for publication, £3,000-£24,000, tenable for 3-24 months. Application materials will be available on this page during September 2026.
